payload.text: **THE COMMAND SURFACE OFFERS ONLY ACTS THAT CAN RUN, AND EVERY OFFERED ACT HAS A REALISER.** (hv ruled the filtered palette over the Lotus bar, 2026-09-02, from three options ic authored; minted by vc under hv's pen the same day, because the behaviour hv asked for was built and nothing in the register would have noticed it regressing.) `/` opens the act vocabulary from the composer in one press; typing narrows it; the pick runs on Enter. **THE ROW IS ABOUT THE ACTS, NOT THE WIDGET** -- a rendering claim belongs to `AC-17.11` and mode visibility to `AC-17.9`, and this row is the one that fails if the palette offers something that cannot happen. **AN ADVERTISED ACT WITH NO REALISER IS THE DEFECT, NOT A PLACEHOLDER**: `MENU` shipped as a painted bar over no model at all, `Hotkey` was declared, emitted, reachable and consumed by nothing, and every existing invariant passed it -- because they all asked whether the MACHINE ANSWERS and none asked whether ANYTHING ACTS. **SO THE PROPERTY IS TWO-SIDED AND BOTH SIDES ARE ASSERTED: every trigger the machine answers is acted on (`every_trigger_the_machine_answers_is_acted_on_by_the_realiser`, whole-`App` comparison, exemptions asserted by count), and the vocabulary declares nothing it cannot perform.** **THE HONEST-SET RULE IS PART OF THE CRITERION AND NOT A NOTE ON IT:** a smaller vocabulary that runs beats a larger one advertising a menu of errors, so `Act` carries no `Unimplemented` arm to park an intention in. **NAVIGATION IS NOT AN ACT AND MUST NOT APPEAR HERE** -- one entry per declared kind already reaches its collection by typing, so a `Go` group would be a second route to a destination the composer reaches better and would bury the acts that have no other route. `/` is for things to DO; typing is for places to GO. **THE RESTING-PALETTE GUARANTEE MOVED ON 2026-09-02 AND THIS ROW RECORDS THE MOVE RATHER THAN LEAVING THE OLD SENTENCE STANDING.** It used to be *the palette at rest shows its WHOLE vocabulary* -- discovery being the reason the surface exists. That stopped being satisfiable when `AC-17.16`'s CLI roster took the vocabulary from four acts to dozens, because a dropdown holding all of them is the body eaten, which is the defect the match cap exists to prevent. **THE GUARANTEE IS NOW: at rest the palette offers the TOP of the vocabulary in declared order, every ACT is among them, and `/help` carries the full list.** The purpose survives -- an operator can still find out what is available -- and the letter moved. **AND THE OLD ASSERTION COULD NOT HAVE TOLD ANYONE IT HAD MOVED, WHICH IS WORTH MORE THAN THE MOVE:** while the vocabulary was four acts and the cap was eight, *all of it* and *the first cap* WERE THE SAME SET, so the test could not distinguish which of the two properties it was making -- it read as the strong one and was only ever the weak one. **A test whose two candidate meanings have identical extensions is not a weak test, it is an UNDECIDED one, and nothing in its output says which one you have.** The roster growing is what separated them. Same family as an invariant fitted to a single observed failure whose founding population could not exhibit the difference.
